name: Minoh Beer
about: Minoh Beer is a family brewery in Minoh, just north of Osaka, a town known for its waterfall, autumn leaves and wild monkeys. The company was set up in 1996 and began brewing the following year in a town the founder picked himself. His daughter, Kaori Oshita, now runs it.
The brewery's stated aim is everyday beer. Its core range sticks to classic styles, and seasonal releases bring in local ingredients such as Minoh yuzu.
